description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source testing platform. It handles dashboard execution features such as initializing page settings, user rights, GUI components, and processing test plan and build information. It includes functions to set up the environment, manage user permissions, load configuration details, and prepare data for rendering the execution dashboard.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project related operations, instantiated in the code for retrieving test project info.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class managing project hierarchy nodes, used here to determine test project hierarchy information.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for handling attachments, instantiated here for attachment management.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class for managing test plan data and operations, used for retrieving test plan details and associated builds.

classes.name: build_mgr
classes.description: Class for managing build information within test plans.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class that manages platform-related data linked to test projects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments related to test plan, project, build, and platform IDs from session/request.

methods.name: initializeRights
methods.description: Sets up user rights for executing, deleting, editing test executions, and managing test cases based on user permissions.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI configuration data including test plan, platform, build details, and user interface preferences for the dashboard.

methods.name: getContextFromGlobalScope
methods.description: Extracts contextual scope information such as build and platform IDs from session or request parameters.
